_meta.description: Comprehensive global data on crime rates (homicide, theft, assault, cybercrime, organized crime), justice systems (incarceration, police, courts, death penalty), safety (road deaths, workplace fatalities, terrorism, firearms), and perception/trust (safety indices, trust in police, corruption). Sources: UNODC, World Prison Brief, WHO, Global Peace Index, Global Terrorism Index, Gallup, Amnesty International, Small Arms Survey, Transparency International, ILO.
